exceptions.reason: Class point responses now expose the revision-owning class entity unless callers explicitly request the collection expansion.
exceptions.migration: Use `include=collection` for the expanded, untagged representation.
exceptions.changelog_entry: class point routes return the class entity by default

exceptions.reason: Permission reads and mutations now return revision-owning permission-set representations instead of the prior flattened records and empty mutation responses.
exceptions.migration: Clients must update deserializers for these response shapes.
exceptions.changelog_entry: SQL permission reads return `{collection_id, revision, permissions}`

exceptions.reason: Group membership reads and mutations now return revision-owning membership entities rather than flattened principals or empty mutation responses.
exceptions.migration: Clients must update deserializers for these response shapes.
exceptions.changelog_entry: group member lists return membership entities with an optional nested principal

exceptions.reason: Canonical user and service-account responses use stable identity-scope identifiers and leave mutable provider metadata to expanded list views.
exceptions.migration: Rich metadata remains available from the corresponding untagged list responses.
exceptions.changelog_entry: canonical tagged user and service-account points use stable `identity_scope_id` values

exceptions.reason: Canonical group responses omit synchronization timestamps because those operational fields do not advance the group's resource revision.
exceptions.migration: The fields remain available in untagged group and token lists.
exceptions.changelog_entry: canonical tagged group points omit directory-sync timestamps

exceptions.reason: Canonical user responses omit synchronization timestamps because those operational fields do not advance the user's resource revision.
exceptions.migration: Rich metadata remains available from the corresponding untagged list responses.
exceptions.changelog_entry: canonical tagged user and service-account points use stable `identity_scope_id` values

exceptions.reason: The event-delivery worker lease token is an internal capability and must not be exposed through public API responses.
exceptions.migration: API clients must stop deserializing or depending on this field.
exceptions.changelog_entry: Event-delivery API responses no longer expose the internal `claim_token` worker lease capability

exceptions.reason: Oasdiff 1.16 reports request/response directionality changes for reused tagged-enum components even though the TokenResourceScope and RemoteInvocationSubject component schemas are structurally identical to v0.0.9.
exceptions.migration: No client migration is required because the token-resource and remote-invocation `oneOf` variants are schema-identical to v0.0.9.
exceptions.changelog_entry: Public HTTP request and response shapes are unchanged
